summary.text: Andrea Bond-Johnson is the Democratic candidate for the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 80, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She was the Democratic nominee for Tennessee House District 82 in 2018 and 2020.

paragraphs.text: Andrea Bond-Johnson ran for Tennessee House District 82 in 2018, losing the general election to Republican Chris Hurt, 57.2 percent to 42.8 percent.
She ran again in 2020 and lost to Hurt, then the incumbent, 58.9 percent to 41.1 percent.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for District 80 on August 6, 2026.
